title: openai-compat: passthrough seed & metadata for Responses API, improve streaming determinism
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Customers using the OpenAI Responses compatibility layer expect deterministic outputs when they provide a seed and to have arbitrary user metadata passed back from the service. This PR plumbs a seed/determinism flag and metadata passthrough through the Responses adapter and stabilizes streaming chunks for seeded requests so that deterministic runs produce stable stream boundaries. Changes: 1) Add seed and deterministic flag handling in openai_compat/responses_adapter: passthrough the `seed` field into the runtime request and mark deterministic mode for the streaming path where applicable. 2) Ensure metadata (user-provided `metadata` and internal `annotations`) are passed through the compat layer and surfaced on Response objects exactly as the upstream contract expects. 3) Update streaming implementation to use deterministic chunk boundaries when deterministic mode is enabled to avoid nondeterministic chunk splits that broke few-shot reproduce tests. 4) Add unit and integration tests that assert seed determinism across sync and streaming responses and validate metadata passthrough. 5) Add small compatibility shim for older model variants that did not support explicit seed; shim is opt-in and falls back to existing randomness. Backwards compatibility: Default behavior unchanged unless caller supplies `seed` or `deterministic=true`. Migration notes: No forced migration; consumers who rely on deterministic streaming should set deterministic=true and include a seed. Checklist: - [x] Add adapter logic and runtime request mapping - [x] Add deterministic streaming implementation and tests - [x] Add metadata passthrough plumbing - [x] Update unit/integration tests - [x] Update docs and changelog - [x] CI green Testing: Added tests under openai_compat/tests including deterministic stream replay tests and cross-compat checks with the legacy openai shim. Impact: Improves compatibility with OpenAI Responses semantics for seed/determinism and metadata; helps reproduce model outputs for evaluation and mitigates flaky downstream consumers that relied on stream chunking determinism.
commits: feat(openai-compat): passthrough seed and deterministic flag to runtime
fix(streaming): use deterministic chunking when deterministic mode enabled
test(openai-compat): add deterministic streaming and metadata passthrough tests

release_notes: OpenAI Responses compatibility: seed/determinism flags and metadata are now passed through the compatibility layer. Streaming path uses deterministic chunking when deterministic mode is enabled. See docs/openai_compat.md for usage and migration notes.
